# PadLeft

Pads text on the left to a given length.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
PadLeft(text, length, [padding])
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | The text to pad. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. |
| `length` | number | The length the result must reach, in UTF-16 code units: a whole number from 0 to 1000000. A negative, fractional or larger number is a runtime error. Text that is already this long or longer is returned unchanged. |
| `padding` | string, optional | The character to pad with: a string of exactly one UTF-16 code unit; any other length, the empty string included, is a runtime error. A number or a boolean is read as its string form. When it is left out, or null, a space is used. |

## Returns

String. The text with padding added before it until it is length long, or the text unchanged when it is already that long. Never null.

## Example

`PadLeft("42", 5, "0")` returns `"00042"`.
